summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning an authored Level 0 maze, deeper levels and shared destinations. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors while place simulations and shared scripts own environments, NPCs, combat, loot, crafting, UI and progression; a separate Tripo cat pipeline feeds an unattached debug wardrobe demo.
places: places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops and landmarks, simulated staff and shoppers, arcade and salon; escalator deco and moving steps have motor hum.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates maze furniture/loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade and Zenith's sealed breach.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking space and staged tutorial route with HALOGEN.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, recorder quest and drone-refilled posts.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone garage maze and M.E.G. camp; Pipe Dreams industrial rooms/camp/fixtures; Level 2.1 Locked.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; Level 4/5 authored residents and fixtures.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11, places/level12 (3D) - later levels including Level 7's drowned house and Level 11's generated city, canal/bridges, crawl and renovation office.
places/level26, places/level27, places/debug, places/spamton (3D) - Level 26 quests, Level 27 Bunker Springs, debug studio and Spamton destination.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, ordered behavior composition and keyboard/touch action mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place configuration, authored placements and local generated/ticked behavior; Level 11 entry is places/level11/sim.js tick.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, body-style toggle and solo pause time-scale.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js + Level 1 geometry scripts - seeded ground-floor/deck generation and shared deck/ramp layout.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD/panels and inventory/equipment/quick-slot UI.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player journal, tracking, objective resolution and markers; folds legacy quest state into shared records.
scripts/lib/dina-quest.js + places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene - Dina camp/diary quest entry; Voss and Cabin 23/Phoebe/stow-nest interactions are in Level 26.
places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene - authored mall placements; escalator shells/steps/audio use bonus assets, scripts/esc-step.js and art/bonus-mall/escalator.py builder.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, LEVEL_NAMES used by hub-ui; LEVEL_NAMES still includes absent testlab.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, item descriptions, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric leaf/frame/sealed-set geometry and eased hinge motion shared by built and level-specific doors.
scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawl-geo.js + Level 11 data - security gates, crawl geometry, rooms, foe roster and storeroom.
scripts/l11-masonry.js + scripts/l11-reno.js + scripts/l11-mall.js - Level 11 canal/quay/renovation geometry and strip-mall shell/cloth awnings parameterized by kind and dimensions.

scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml - canonical breakable/material/build specs and furniture models shared by B-mode, harvesting and reconstruction.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter-models.yml + wardrobe*.yml + scripts/lib/clothes.js - shared furry/optional-human player/NPC appearance system; separate from the demo cat wardrobe.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml + scripts/mat-catskin.js + scripts/mat-cloth.js - Tripo cat demo body, painted clothes/prints and skinned garments/masks; imports PRINTS from mat-cloth.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update; scripts/esc-step.js - onSpawn, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fishNibble, HOLO/holoEnd; throwable fuse/arm callbacks and blast hits.
scripts/lib/quick-items.js - quickItems, assignQuick; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - setStyle, HUMAN, STYLE_V, armSplay, appearance builders, restylePlace/Queue/Step and clearAppearanceCache.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, stagger3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus, maxMakes, craftOne, benchAvailable, stationOf, scrapCount, CRAFT_LIMIT, CATS; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update.
scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY, paintOf, skinParams, catModel, chestOf, catChildren, printOf; scripts/mat-cloth.js - PRINTS.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, heat/cold and carried tapes/playback.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut, and seeds player.state.quests['the-way-back']; scripts/lib/quests.js owns player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; level quest handlers own their per-player quest fields.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, drag/heave/throw session fields and carryMul; held targets own heldBy/down/stagger state.

scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js - loose props own state.loose/mat/hp and flight sessions; breakables own wreck transitions and permanently smashed root IDs in place.state.gone; both guard Bonus.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.
places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level4/sim.js and places/level27/sim.js - place-state migration/version markers and one-time conversions (officeV, islandSplit in Level 4).

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + scripts/prop-part.js - prop state owns interactiveV, propArt, containerOpen/lampOn and part motion goals; child sessions track native tween keys while prop parts animate from replicated state.

scripts/cat-demo.js owns demo object's sex/look/clip inputs; scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js derives model/material parameters and garment/mask children from sex/look, while shaders consume those material parameters.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors for locomotion, player/foe steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest markers.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.

scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs; toHub/toSolo perform crossings and track roomHop/save-place state.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.

Main-menu BODIES action → player.state.bodyStyle and world.state.bodyStyle; scripts/lib/critter-model.js setStyle reads world bodyStyle and selects humans only for 'human', otherwise furry; Bonus sim applies this before NPC updates/redress.

scripts/lib/hub.js destinations → hub-ui.js and hub.js crossings; Bonus sim lays NPCs/effects and mall counters write shop/food state consumed by handlers/UI; Bonus escalator step entities run scripts/esc-step.js loops from their feet position.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.

interact.js focus → player.state.focus and loot-ui.js prompt only on the play screen; ui-theme/screen hide prompts behind panels; interact.js clears focus outlines in menus/talk/cutscenes/build mode. Talk UI emits talk/talkdo/shop actions.

interact.js openLoot/closeLoot → prop-interactions.containerPose → child part state.goal; scripts/prop-part.js samples cubic motion and builtin tween animates articulated storage fronts; toggleLamp flips light part goals.

scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js interactiveSpec → generated furniture from scripts/lib/furniture.js and upgradeNearby nearby legacy props; preserves root collider/state and tags; prop-part children provide moving doors/drawers/lids.

Player craft action/UI → scripts/lib/craft.js stationOf + craft.yml; built pieces in breakables.yml carry bench=cook/ammo and state.station; craft.js/craft-ui.js filter station recipes while hand menu lists all recipes.

cat-demo onSpawn/ears redress reads state.sex/look/clip → cat-wardrobe selects body, painted skin and skinned garment/mask children; mat-catskin paints bind-pose regions with soft toon lighting; printOf uses mat-cloth PRINTS for chest/sleeves.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + objects.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + bonus-extra and mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall, NPC attachments and simulation; escalator decoration has frozen steps removed and moving step loops.

art/bonus-mall/escalator.py + world.assets bonus-mall-deco-moving-escalators/escalator-step + scripts/esc-step.js - offline Blender build strips frozen tread geometry and makes reusable detailed steps; scene placements vary direction and pitch.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + home reconstruction scripts - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and scripts/lib/prop-interactions.js + interactive-props.yml + prop-part.js - parametric/eased doors and authored animated storage parts, fitted to supported kinds and migrated while preserving existing roots.
places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + Zenith door/bots/hatch/flicker/drones/use scripts - Zenith Station geometry, breach, hazards and interactive systems.

places/level4 scenes + places/level4/sim.js + scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + Level 4/5 resident data - authored office/hotel props, fixtures, NPC bodies and attached critter behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter-models.yml + wardrobe*.yml + clothes.js + art/critter-cute and art/critter-andy - shared furry/optional-human avatars; art/critter-cute/tripo_rig.py builds Mixamo-rigged cat bodies with fitted face decals.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + cat-wardrobe.yml + mat-catskin.js + mat-cloth.js + art/cat-wardrobe/masks.py - debug wardrobe selects female rigged-7 and male rigged-6 bodies; per-sex skinned garments and head-bone masks, painted layers/prints; tripo_rig.py repairs muzzle holes and chin/jaw surface before decal fitting.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved tune-aware fitter copy with no references found; active fit.py is the fitter used by its documented Blender command.
scripts/cat-demo.js - standalone debug-studio behavior consumes the cat wardrobe, but no scene or other package attachment/reference found.
migrationNotes: Avatar STYLE_V is sw159. CLOTHES_OFF is true: clothes.js rowOf returns null (wear tokens and clothing DR vanish) and critter-model.js omits legacy mesh garments; switch deliberately if clothes return.

Current furry body GLBs in scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml are thick, smoothed Andy variants with shortened arms (hands retained); female uses the soft-chest GLB and bodyOld holds prior furry assets for migration/compatibility.
Bare furry avatars show the whole Body shell and hide segmented Skin_* regions to avoid overlapping seams; STYLE_V is in the appearance cache key so existing avatars redraw after asset changes.
NPC body-style changes are processed in batches of six per update via self.session.rq; preserve the queue lifecycle and exclude player/local-only objects rather than synchronously sweeping a place.

Tripo cat wardrobe is separate from legacy critter clothing; the demo now points to female cat-female-rigged-7 and male cat-male-rigged-6 GLBs, with earlier rigged revisions retained as assets; garments remain per-sex skinned children and masks attach to the head bone.

Cat skin/print measurements are bind-pose metres, y-up, front +z; tripo_rig.py fits the muzzle/decal to the face curve and now fills mouth gaps and relaxes/caps chin and jaw surfaces before pressing the decal; mat-catskin.js owns soft toon bands and ambient/environment response.
